text:
anna: Hey all — I'm in the onboarding cohort and want to double-check tomorrow's session schedule. My calendar shows Zoom links for 'Company Overview' and 'Product Tour' but the event times look like "UTC" and I'm in PST. Also I couldn't find the recording for last week's prework — where do recordings get uploaded? Thanks!

jamie: Welcome @anna! Recordings go into the New Hires Drive folder. We also attach them to the calendar event after we redact anything sensitive. Which prework session are you missing?

anna: The one titled 'Prework: infra & security' from last Wed — I don't see it in Drive or the calendar event.

morgan: @anna that recording was uploaded but put into the Private Onboarding folder while we remove a couple of internal slides. I'll add you — is your email your @redwood one?

anna: yup, anna@redwood.com — thank you 🙏

eli: Re: calendar times — we create invites from a UTC account which can look like "UTC" in the raw invite, but Google/Outlook should render it in your local TZ. If your calendar is showing the wrong time, try toggling event timezone settings or tell me and I can resend an invite locked to PST.

sophie: FYI product tour starts 16:00 UTC / 9:00 AM PST. Recording will be uploaded to Drive and I will paste the link in the event thread afterwards.

anna: sweet — can someone confirm the Zoom passcode? Outlook stripped it for me.

deploy-bot: Zoom meeting created: ID 123-456-7890, passcode: 3721 (auto-posted)

morgan: that's the one. I'll also paste the join link into the calendar description and pin the recording link after the session.

eli: small tip for international folks — use time.is or built-in calendar convert. For CLI nerds: `TZ=\"America/Los_Angeles\" date -d @$(date +%s)` — but maybe just use https://time.is/convert :P

jamie: We also try to have a scribe. @sophie, can you take notes for the product tour? If you can't, I'll assign from the rotation.

sophie: I can scribe, but please note I'll need @morgan to clip/redact a couple slides from the recording before we share org-wide. @morgan?

morgan: Yep, I'll redact those slides and then move the cleaned file into the shared New Hires folder and update Drive perms.

anna: one last thing — I have two product tour invites on my calendar (duplicate). Is it safe to delete one?

eli: delete duplicates, but keep the one that contains "Onboarding Series — official" in the title. If you're unsure, DM me a screenshot and I'll confirm.

jamie: I'll post a short recap in here after the product tour with the recording link, Zoom details, and who has Drive access.

anna: awesome, really appreciate the clarity :smile:
